title: GOV-0006: merged Work Packages stay IN_PROGRESS on main -- no post-merge reconciliation
problem:
## Observed
On `main` at `c510516`, `work/WP-2026-0018/work-package.json` reads `status: IN_PROGRESS` with no `external_target.landed_as` — for a WP that merged **as** `c510516` and whose Issue (#22) is closed. The record was necessarily written before the squash SHA existed, and nothing updates it after the merge. `main` is PR-only, so the correction itself needs a PR, which needs a WP and a demand. `WP-2026-0016` avoided this only by being written late. From here on, **every** WP lands on the ledger as `IN_PROGRESS`.

## Expected
> `main` is the accepted state ledger.
A ledger that says `IN_PROGRESS` for landed work is a false claim on the surface that carries it. After merge the record must state `CLOSED` and `landed_as = <squash SHA>`, and the gate must be able to catch the inconsistent states offline: a record with `landed_as` must be `CLOSED` and its SHA an ancestor of `HEAD`; a `CLOSED` record must carry `landed_as`.

## Evidence
`python3 -c "import json;w=json.load(open('work/WP-2026-0018/work-package.json'));print(w['status'],w['external_target'].get('landed_as'))"` → `IN_PROGRESS None` on `c510516`.

## Unknowns
- Whether the reconciliation PR may be opened autonomously. It is a status transition on the ledger, not new code; the merge stays ruleset-gated.
- Whether `Closes #N` against an already-closed Issue is the right trailer, or whether traceability needs a `Reconciles: BADF-WP-NNNN` form so the chain reads honestly.

## Proposed work package
`BADF-WP-0019` — a deterministic, offline `reconcile <WP> <sha>` subcommand: sets `CLOSED` + `landed_as`; refuses unless the SHA is an ancestor of `origin/main` and its commit body carries the WP's own `Work-Package:` line. `repo` gains the two invariants above. Traceability accepts `Reconciles:`. First run closes `WP-2026-0018`.

discovered-by: BADF-WP-0018 · status: DISCOVERED
note: Body exported verbatim from the GitHub Issue and digest-bound. DISCOVERED by BADF-WP-0018 (the false claim is WP-0018's own record on main c510516). Authority to act: the operator's standing in-session delegation ('Proceed on your call'). Worked as BADF-WP-0019.
